name: reel-map
description: Turn an Instagram Reel into a Google Maps route inside ChatGPT Work, using your existing plan.

interface.shortDescription: From Instagram Reel to places on Google Maps
interface.longDescription: Download a public Reel, inspect its caption and video frames, identify real places, and return one Google Maps route. Runs with ChatGPT Work's tools; no separate LLM API key. A Google Maps shortlist is also available when sourced Google Place IDs are present.
defaultPrompt: Map the places in this Instagram Reel.
